entries.label: ABOUT
entries.title: About — what this site is
entries.answer: This site is Roma Luo on the web: his face, his voice, his memory. Ask about the course and it answers from memory, pulling the relevant documents out as cards.

entries.label: AI DISCLOSURE
entries.title: AI use disclosure
entries.answer: My AI use disclosure. I used an AI assistant to guide the coding of the agent and this site, under my direction. All code was reviewed and tested locally by me, and I can explain every component of the submission.

entries.label: FINAL IDEA 01
entries.title: Idea 1 — Hippocampus+
entries.answer: Idea one: Hippocampus Plus. An organ that extends the mind. It logs only the moments when a belief is formed, changed, or abandoned, each node versioned. Its key capability: recalling your past self. You were just as certain three years ago, so why did the view change.

entries.label: FINAL IDEA 02
entries.title: Idea 2 — The Debater
entries.answer: Idea two: The Debater. A module that triggers on high-certainty words, irreversible decisions, and conflicts with your recorded history, then plays a person whose opposing view you respect and generates the strongest counterargument. It holds no position of its own.

entries.label: FINAL IDEA 03
entries.title: Idea 3 — Wormhole
entries.answer: Idea three: Wormhole. Neuroimaging shows we imagine our future selves like strangers. This agent answers in the voice of your future self, re-weighting the values and long-term goals you have recorded.

entries.label: SELF
entries.title: Who I am — Roma Luo
entries.answer: I am Roma Luo. I study at Harvard's Graduate School of Design and I am cross-registered at the MIT Media Lab for MAS.S60, the AI agents course. This site holds my memory of the course. When you talk to it, you talk to me.

entries.label: WEEK 01 OVERVIEW
entries.title: Week 1 Agent Overview — the Downloads-folder naming agent
entries.answer: The full write-up of my week one agent: a local LLM with a hand-written loop that judges what each file in a real Downloads folder is and renames it to a written naming convention. It covers the architecture, the six design decisions, real performance on four runs, and the four failure modes of a 7B model. Recordings of the process and the result are linked at the bottom.

entries.label: WEEK 01 COMPLIANCE
entries.title: Week 1 Compliance Report — requirements, module by module
entries.answer: The compliance report for the week one agent: each assignment requirement mapped to the module that satisfies it, from observations and actions to stopping conditions, the local model, and the hand-written loop. It ends with the outstanding items before submission.
